summary: Records a grant from IBM that allows conditional free use of one of its patents in connection with the Photuris key management protocol. It is a legal notice rather than a technical document.

plainLanguage.summary: This RFC records IBM's grant concerning a specific patent used with Photuris. The grant applies under stated conditions, including compliance with the protocol.

questions: what patent did ibm grant rights to use with photuris
when does the photuris patent grant apply
when does the patent grant end
subtitle: IBM's public grant concerning use of a patent with the Photuris key management protocol.

tldr.problem: The memo records IBM's terms for use of a specific patent in connection with the Photuris key management protocol.
tldr.mechanism: IBM agrees not to assert the patent against parties that implement and comply with Photuris or a qualifying derivative used with an Internet Protocol.
tldr.outcome: The grant ends for a party that asserts its own patent against IBM for IBM's Photuris implementation. A written confirmation is optional.

facts.label: Grant scope
facts.value: Photuris and qualifying derivatives used with an Internet Protocol

today: RFC 1822 is an Informational public record of a patent grant, and the unit metadata lists no update or replacement. It is not a technical specification.

sections.title: A Patent Grant, Not a Standard
sections.content:
RFC 1822 explicitly says it is not a standard. It is a public record of an IBM grant for use of a specific IBM patent in conjunction with Photuris, the Internet Key Management Protocol contribution IBM offered to the IETF.

The RFC says the grant itself provides the rights. A confirmatory license from IBM is optional.
sections.plainLanguage: This is a record of a patent grant, not a technical specification. The grant is made in the RFC, so a separate written confirmation is optional.

sections.title: When the Grant Applies
sections.content:
IBM covenants not to assert U.S. Patent 5,148,479 or its non-U.S. counterparts against a party that implements Photuris, or a derivative that includes IBM's IKMP contribution, and operates in compliance with Photuris or that derivative. The protocol must be used in connection with an Internet Protocol.

The grant ends for a party that directly or indirectly asserts a patent it owns against IBM for IBM's implementation and compliant operation of Photuris or a qualifying derivative. It ends on the date the patent is asserted.
sections.plainLanguage: IBM promises not to assert this patent against parties that implement and follow Photuris under the stated conditions. The grant ends for a party that asserts its own patent against IBM for IBM's qualifying use.

sections.title: Confirmation and Security Note
sections.content:
A party may request written confirmation of the grant. The RFC also says a request may seek a license under other IBM patents, subject to IBM's then-current terms, conditions and royalty rates.

The Security Considerations section notes that the referenced protocol is security-related; it does not provide technical security guidance.
sections.plainLanguage: A written confirmation is available on request, as are separate licenses for other IBM patents under their terms. The memo only notes that Photuris relates to security.
